top_signals.title: The West Is Thinking Too Small About Ukraine’s Victory
top_signals.summary:
Since fall 2023, Ukraine’s supporters have fallen into a pattern: Ukrainians warn that Russia is targeting its energy infrastructure to prevent them from heating their homes, schools, and businesses in the coming winter. Allies provide insufficient support to Ukraine’s efforts to harden its energy grid and other critical infrastructure. Ukrainians devise new ways to stay warm, stretch the aid they do get as far as it can go, and survive the winter without catastrophic collapse. top_signals.title: Cybercrime crackdown across Africa leads to 1,462 arrests, $105 million seized
top_signals.summary: More than 1,400 suspected cybercriminals were arrested across Africa this summer as part of a crackdown on the gangs perpetrating online fraud, ransomware and business email compromise attacks, Interpol said.

top_signals.title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
top_signals.summary: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
